description: Google Ads’ own advice for the account: the optimization score (account and per campaign), every open recommendation with what applying it would change (budget $X -> $Y, a keyword, a bid target, a Google-written ad) and Google’s weekly impact estimate, each tagged spend (changes what the account buys) or serves (changes what an ad shows), plus which types Google is auto-applying by itself. An empty list means Google has no advice yet, never that the account is optimal. Ids go stale fast, so act on a fresh read. Read-only, 0 credits.

customerId.description: 10-digit account id, omit for the brand’s default account

loginCustomerId.description: manager id if operating through an MCC

types.description: recommendation types, e.g. CAMPAIGN_BUDGET, KEYWORD; an unknown one is refused by name

name: google_ads_recommendations
title: Google Ads recommendations + optimization score
